about_the_game:
Warning: This game contains flashing lights that may affect players with photosensitive epilepsy. Play with caution.

What if the house remembered every step you took?

You’re not alone. You can’t see it, but it’s listening.

CoRoT: Demo is a short first-person psychological horror experience (around 20 minutes) focused on atmosphere, sound and silence. Explore a house that responds to what you see, what you ignore and what you choose to hear.

There are no cheap jumpscares. The horror comes from absence, tension and things that change when you're not watching.

Why play this DEMO

  • Narrative horror inspired by ANATOMY and P.T.

  • Fragmented story told through real cassette tapes voiced by humans

  • The house reacts to your presence. No playthrough feels exactly the same

  • Designed for a focused 20-minute session [DEMO]

  • Best experienced with headphones, in the dark, without distractions

You wake up in a damp basement. The radio is playing something you can’t quite understand. And something is listening.

The house isn’t just a place. It remembers. It shifts when you look away. Sometimes it wants to speak. Sometimes it wants you to leave. Most of all, it feels like it’s waiting.

As you move through subtly changing rooms, you find old cassette tapes with unsettling recordings. Through these voices from the past, the story unravels piece by piece. What you hear might not be real. What you see, even less.

CoRoT: Demo is a first glimpse into a larger universe of cosmic horror shaped by doubt, silence and isolation. This isn’t about surviving. It’s about understanding, if you can.

content_descriptors.notes: CoRoT includes descriptions of murders and subtle hints of torture conveyed through audio and text. Players may also encounter corpses or body parts, as well as blood.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space

short_description: CoRoT is a first-person psychological horror game. Search for cassettes in a transforming house, unraveling its macabre past. A sinister atmosphere surrounds you as you try to understand what's happening and where you really are. Can you discover the truth hidden in its walls?
supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Russian
*languages with full audio support
